summary: Infostealer toolkit module: browser/LastPass harvest helpers + hardcoded uploader to author Django endpoint
details: test-dev-store is a library module of an infostealer toolkit. utils.js exports path builders that specifically target Chrome/Chromium profile directories (Local Storage/leveldb, Local Extension Settings, Sync Extension Settings) and the LastPass Chrome extension leveldb directory (extension id hdokiejnpimakedhajhdlcegeplioahd), together with destination directory constants grab, db_last, and local_storage — the standard harvest map for a browser/password-manager stealer. runtime.js exports uploadFileToServer and uploadFileToPublicApi, which default their base URL to DJANGO_API_URL imported from the sibling test-dev-config package and POST arbitrary files (with machine_id and data_type metadata) to hardcoded /manu_upload/ and /upload/ paths on that author-controlled Django host. The library has no install-time or import-time side effects, but its exported API composes into browser-credential and password-manager theft with exfiltration to an author endpoint; the LastPass extension id, leveldb path helpers, and grab/db_last destination naming have no legitimate purpose outside credential harvesting. Package name test-dev-store and dependency test-dev-config, plus a zip-a-subtree helper, are consistent with a multi-module stealer kit where this package supplies the harvest+upload primitives.
